title: France looks to exchange its 'support to Iran deal with increased US support to Ukraine'
summary: France is launching a charm operation on the US. Macron is hoping to get increased support to Ukraine and bring back US sanctions on Russia and Putin, with France hoping to seal the deal during a dinner in the sumptuous palace of Versailles on June 17. FRANCE 24's Philip Turle tells us more about what France is trying to achieve with the United States from…
